text_to_image_prompt: Premium refined semi-realistic 2.5D/3D character render, sculpted beautiful face, delicate skin microtexture and subsurface scattering, crisp eyes, fine individual hair strands, richly detailed fabric and metal physically based materials. Pure opaque white seamless studio background, bright soft neutral frontal light with fill, no colored cast, no text, no labels, no border, no watermark. Preserve CG material finish, not a photograph or flat illustration. An adult woman with glossy black hair in a high ponytail with a small gathered knot and face-framing strands, gray eyes, defined winged eyeliner, pale peach skin and muted rose lips. Silver ear cuffs, thorn-shaped silver choker and layered cross necklace. Black velvet halter evening gown, poised contemporary gothic styling. Continue the black velvet halter evening gown into an opaque ankle-length gently flared skirt with subtle thorn silver trim, black low heel ankle-strap shoes, black lace arm bands. Tall healthy 180 cm lean athletic build. Exactly nine head-and-shoulders portraits of this ONE SAME person in a clean 3 by 3 equal panel expression grid, every face front-facing eye-level same scale and consistent face hair clothes. Row1 neutral, gentle closed-mouth smile, happy open smile; row2 surprise mouth O, worried frown, quiet sadness; row3 focused anger, skeptical raised eyebrow, playful small wink. Expressions clearly distinct but attractive and natural. Full hair and shoulders inside each cell. Square overall canvas. Narrow white gutters, no text.
